description: public.utf16-external-plain-text from the macOS general pasteboard (2 items)
how: Created /private/tmp/rclip-capture/files/{alpha.txt,beta.txt}, opened that folder in Finder, selected both, Edit > Copy. Two NSPasteboardItems, one per file.
notes: The same CR-separated display names as UTF-16LE with a ff fe BOM.
